27903-the-magic-world.title: The Magic World
27903-the-magic-world.creator: E. Nesbit
27903-the-magic-world.description: A book by E. Nesbit. To have your hair cut is not painful, nor does it hurt to have your whiskers trimmed. But round wooden shoes, shaped like bowls, are not comfortable wear, however much it may amuse the onlooker to see you try to walk in them. If you have a nice fur coat like a company promoter's, it is most annoying to be made to swim in it.

arxiv-1406-1918.creator: Zbigniew Szadkowski, for the Pierre Auger Collaboration
arxiv-1406-1918.description: Abstract The surface detector (SD) array of the Pierre Auger Observatory containing at present 1680 water Cherenkov detectors spread over an area of 3000 km 2 started to operate since 2004. The currently used Front-End Boards are equipped with no-more produced ACEX ® and obsolete Cyclone ® FPGA (40 MSps/15-bit of dynamic range).

arxiv-1912-04425.title: Renormalization of a Contact Interaction on a Lattice
arxiv-1912-04425.creator: Christopher Körber, Evan Berkowitz, Thomas Luu
arxiv-1912-04425.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Christopher Körber, Evan Berkowitz, Thomas Luu. Contact interactions can be used to describe a system of particles at unitarity, contribute to the leading part of nuclear interactions and are numerically non-trivial because they require a proper regularization and renormalization scheme. We explain how to tune the coefficient of a contact interaction between non-relativistic particles on a discretized space in 1, 2, and 3 spatial dimensions such that we can remove all discretization artifacts.

Andrews, Jaehan Bae, Jennifer B. Bergner, Alice S. Booth, Arthur D. Bosman, Gianni Cataldi, Ian Czekala, Jane Huang, John D. Ilee, Charles J. Law,
arxiv-2109-06202.description: Abstract Understanding the temperature structure of protoplanetary disks is key to interpreting observations, predicting the physical and chemical evolution of the disk, and modeling planet formation processes. In this study, we constrain the two-dimensional thermal structure of the disk around Herbig Ae star HD 163296.

arxiv-2111-02379.title: Unique continuation from a crack’s tip under Neumann boundary conditions
arxiv-2111-02379.creator: Veronica Felli and Giovanni Siclari
arxiv-2111-02379.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Veronica Felli and Giovanni Siclari. We derive local asymptotics of solutions to second order elliptic equations at the edge of a ( N − 1 ) (N-1) -dimensional crack, with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions prescribed on both sides of the crack. A combination of blow-up analysis and monotonicity arguments provides a classification of all possible asymptotic homogeneities of solutions at the crack’s tip, together with a a strong unique continuation principle. Crack singularities; monotonicity formula; unique continuation; blow-up analysis. MSC2020 classification.

arxiv-2201-02797.title: A Unified Review of Deep Learning for Automated Medical Coding Journal: JACM Volume: 37 4 111 8 CCS: Applied computing Health care information systems CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing CCS: Applied computing Document management and text processing
arxiv-2201-02797.creator: Shaoxiong Ji, Xiaobo Li, Wei Sun, Hang Dong, Ara Taalas, Yijia Zhang, Honghan Wu, Esa Pitkänen, Pekka Marttinen
arxiv-2201-02797.description: Abstract . Automated medical coding, an essential task for healthcare operation and delivery, makes unstructured data manageable by predicting medical codes from clinical documents. Recent advances in deep learning and natural language processing have been widely applied to this task. However, deep learning-based medical coding lacks a unified view of the design of neural network architectures.

arxiv-2508-18781.title: AniME: Adaptive Multi-Agent Planning for Long Animation Generation
arxiv-2508-18781.creator: Lisai Zhang, Baohan Xu, Siqian Yang, Mingyu Yin, Jing Liu, Chao Xu, Siqi Wang, Yidi Wu, Yuxin Hong, Zihao Zhang, Yanzhang Liang, Yudong Jiang
arxiv-2508-18781.description: Abstract . We present AniME , a director-oriented multi-agent system for automated long-form anime production, covering the full workflow from a story to the final video. The director agent keeps a global memory for the whole workflow, and coordinates several downstream specialized agents.

pmc-10582559.title: Micro-costing analysis of suspected lower respiratory tract infection care in a French emergency department
pmc-10582559.creator: Valérie Wilmé, Érik-André Sauleau, Pierrick Le Borgne, Éric Bayle, Pascal Bilbault, Sabrina Kepka
pmc-10582559.description: IntroductionIn the context of budgetary constraints faced by healthcare systems, the medical-economic evaluation of care strategies becomes essential. In particular, valuing consumed resources in the overcrowded emergency departments (EDs) has become a priority to adopt more efficient approaches in treating the growing number of patients. However, precisely measuring the cost of care is challenging.

pmc-10742399.title: A Retrospective Analysis of High Resolution Ultrasound Evaluation of the “Split Fat Sign” in Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
pmc-10742399.creator: Jeena B. Deka, Ritu Shah, Miguel Jiménez, Nidhi Bhatnagar, Alfredo Bravo-Sánchez, Inés Piñas-Bonilla, Javier Abián-Vicén, Fernando Jiménez
pmc-10742399.description: Peripheral nerve sheath tumors (PNST) comprise schwannomas and neurofibromas. The finding of increased adipose tissue around benign PNSTs has been described as the “split fat sign” on magnetic resonance imaging exams, which is suggestive of an intramuscular or intermuscular location of the tumor. However, few studies have described this sign as a salient ultrasound feature of PNSTs.

pmc-11310959.title: Effects of a Nutraceutical Treatment on the Intestinal Microbiota of Sled Dogs
pmc-11310959.creator: Benedetta Belà, Paolo Emidio Crisi, Giulia Pignataro, Isa Fusaro, Alessandro Gramenzi
pmc-11310959.description: Simple SummaryPhysical activity is often associated with stress and production of radical oxygen species able to alter the composition of the intestinal microbiota. Usually, sporting dogs present gastrointestinal disorders with a dysbiotic intestinal ecosystem; this alteration is also found in various pathological states. To date, it is not yet clear whether dysbiosis is a cause or a consequence of disease.

pmc-11402081.title: Perception, experience, and practice of Iraqi community pharmacists towards customers with substance use disorder
pmc-11402081.creator: Ehab Mudher Mikhael, Nisreen Jumaah Jebur, Mohammed Yawuz Jamal, Tabarak Arkan Hameed
pmc-11402081.description: Background:Pharmacists are healthcare professionals who frequently encounter individuals struggling with addiction in their day-to-day practice. Studies critique pharmacists’ competence in the detection, prevention, and management of substance use disorder.Objective:This study aimed to get in-depth information about the perception, experience, and practice of Iraqi pharmacists towards substance use disorder.Methods:A qualitative-study was performed through face-to-face individual-based interviews with community pharmacists in Baghdad/Iraq.

pmc-11635913.creator: Guodong Gong, You Zhou, Ziyu Xiong, Tao Sun, Huaxin Li, Qingxiu Li, Wenyu Zhao, Guohua Zhang, Yongbiao Zhai, Ziyu Lv, Hongwei Tan, Ye Zhou, Su‐Ting Han
pmc-11635913.description: Machine vision systems that consist of cameras and image‐processing components for visual inspection and identification tasks play a critical role in various intelligent applications, including pilotless vehicles and surveillance systems. However, current systems usually possess a limited dynamic range and fixed photoresponsivity, restricting their capability of gaining high‐fidelity images when encoding a high‐contrast scene.

pmc-12534282.title: Differentiation grade is highly concordant between matched primary and metastatic colorectal cancer
pmc-12534282.creator: Camilla M Reehorst, Jennifer K Mooi, Charles J Uy, Kristen A Needham, Sarah Ellis, Ian Y Luk, Laura J Jenkins, Rebecca Nightingale, Fiona Chionh, Andreas Behren, Niall C Tebbutt, David S Williams, John M Mariadason
pmc-12534282.description: Differentiation grade of colorectal cancers (CRC) is histologically defined by the proportion of the tumour which retains the glandular architecture of the normal colon. Poorly differentiated CRCs display loss of glandular architecture and canonical markers of colonic differentiation and are associated with increased metastatic capacity and poorer prognosis.

pmc-13038705.title: A bibliometric and visual analysis of colorectal cancer liver metastasis research from 2015 to 2025
pmc-13038705.creator: Xingxing Xiao, Xiaohe Sun, Jin Sun, Haibo Cheng, Jing Shu
pmc-13038705.description: ObjectiveColorectal cancer liver metastasis (CCLM) is a common and serious complication of colorectal cancer and is one of the main causes of patient death. This study examines the trend of CCLM research using bibliometric and visualization analysis to provide a reference for further research.

pmc-13247297.title: Canal Construction Disrupts Camouflage in Two Sympatric Estuarine Crab Species
pmc-13247297.creator: Yiran Huang, Sichen Lu, Fuxi Lai, Binyu Zhai, Yuhao Liao, Haitao Wang, Rongping Bu
pmc-13247297.description: Estuarine ecosystems provide essential habitats for fiddler crabs, whose survival heavily relies on background‐matching camouflage. Anthropogenic modifications such as canal construction can alter the visual properties of these habitats, yet direct empirical evidence of its impact on crustacean camouflage remains limited.

uslaw-usc-t31-s324.title: 31 U.S.C. § 324 — Disposing and extending the maturity of obligations
uslaw-usc-t31-s324.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t31-s324.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 3 (Department Of The Treasury); Subchapter II (Administrative). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary of the Treasury may— (1) dispose of obligations— (A) acquired by the Secretary for the United States Government; or (B) delivered by an executive agency; and (2) make arrangements to extend the maturity of those obligations.
